metricConfig.description: Configuration for a specific metric type

level.description: The collection level for the metric type

scrapeInterval.description: The interval in seconds between metric scrapes

resourceValues.description: CPU and memory quantities (Kubernetes resource quantity strings, e.g. "500m", "512Mi")

description: Configuration schema for Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Observability AddOn for EKS

affinity.description: Affinity rules for the observability operator pod, deep-merged with the operator's built-in affinity (its default node-affinity preference is retained unless the same keys are overridden). https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#affinity-and-anti-affinity

arn.description: The ARN of the AMG workspace

workspaceName.description: The name of the AMG workspace

ampWorkspace.description: Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus (AMP) workspace configuration

arn.description: The ARN of the AMP workspace

prometheusEndpoint.description: The endpoint URL for the AMP workspace

collectorResources.description: Compute resource requests and limits for the OpenTelemetry collector workloads managed by the observability operator.

centralCollector.description: Resources for the central collector Deployment pods.

nodeCollector.description: Resources for the node collector DaemonSet pods.

metricsPath.description: HTTP path to scrape metrics from (default: /metrics)

scrapeInterval.description: Override default scrape interval in seconds (30–300)

metricsProvider.description: Configuration for different types of metrics collection

acceleratedComputeMetrics.description: Configuration for accelerated compute (GPU) metrics collection

taskGovernanceMetrics.description: Configuration for task governance metrics collection

nodeSelector.description: Node selector constraining the observability operator pod to nodes carrying the specified labels. https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#nodeselector

podAnnotations.description: Custom annotations merged onto the observability operator pod. https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/annotations/

podLabels.description: Custom labels merged onto the observability operator pod. https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass assigned to the observability operator pod. The named class must already exist on the cluster. https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/pod-priority-preemption/

resources.description: Compute resource requests and limits for the observability operator container. https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/

tolerations.description: Additional tolerations applied to the observability operator pod, allowing it to schedule onto nodes with matching taints. These are appended to the operator's built-in tolerations (which are always present). https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/taint-and-toleration/
